cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — standing; A sheltered roof above a far-future monorail corridor at night — She tests a paper glider on a narrow bench; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — holds a towel folded against her chest; overgrown jungle temple ruins — holds her keepsake at chest height; A civilian orbital reading room lit by the first pale dawn light — She uses an optical viewer to decipher the folds of a paper puzzle; her bedroom — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — reads a book held open in both hands; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — standing with one foot up on a step; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the Changban Bridge memorial — rests the pen from a notebook against her lips
